title: Vietnamese-Style Baked Banana Coconut Cake
summary: A tender baked banana cake inspired by Vietnamese chuối nướng, with ripe bananas, coconut milk and a softly chewy, golden top. Serve warm or at room temperature as a comforting vegetarian dessert.

ingredients.name: butter, melted, plus extra for greasing

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Grease a 20 cm square or similar baking dish with a little of the melted butter.
Put the coconut milk, sugar, melted butter, vanilla extract and salt in a large bowl and whisk until the sugar starts to dissolve.
Whisk in the plain flour until you have a smooth, thick batter with no dry patches, then stir in the desiccated coconut.
Fold in most of the sliced bananas gently, keeping a few attractive slices aside for the top.
Pour the batter into the prepared dish and smooth the surface. Arrange the reserved banana slices on top in an even layer.
Bake for 50–60 minutes, until the cake is deep golden at the edges, set in the centre and a skewer inserted into the middle comes out mostly clean with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the dish for at least 20 minutes before slicing. Serve warm for a soft pudding-like texture, or fully cooled for cleaner slices.
